policy.line_growth: Existing hotspots may shrink but not grow; new production modules must stay at or below 800 lines.
policy.public_surface: Per-file and per-crate public item and re-export counts may shrink but not grow without review.
policy.ranking: Ranking combines production LOC, history, contributors, defects, public surface, state/lock ownership, fan-out, and test cost.
